items.what: Data: the Schroter 2008 per-temperature period and length table was not obtainable (Wiley returned 403, the paper is not in PMC), and Kicheva 2007 and Yu 2009 are not open. The task's planned temperature hold-out for A and the Dpp/Wg/Fgf8-2009 records for B were therefore not done. Soroldoni 2014 and mouse, snake and frog data were not reached in the time.

Law A: S = v*T is only non-trivial if v and T are measured independently. At 27 C the published fits give 25.5 um per somite, while raw tail growth is 27.5 to 32.7 um per somite in held-out embryos. The same paper quotes PSM shrinkage of 24 um per somite, so 'v' is ambiguous (tail growth vs PSM shrinkage vs wavefront), and the checked Lean file does not say which.

Law A across temperature: the temperature cancellation is true by construction of the two published fits (both proportional to T - 14.4). I did not test it on raw per-temperature data, so it is not a held-out result.

Law B: with FRAP D and measured k, the law over-predicts the Nodal gradient length 4 to 6 times; with FCS D of about 60 um2/s it would be over 20 times. The single-D, single-k formula ignores binding to receptors and uses whichever D the assay gives. For Fgf8, sqrt(D) scaling predicted a 27% shortening where 11% was measured.

Earlier agent work: I did NOT read hv-morph-segmentation.json or hv-mol-morphogen.json in tracks/research/agents (only their sizes were checked), so I cannot report errors in them. That stage of the task is not done.
Earlier Lean: MorphogenGradient.lean takes lam^2 = D*tau as a hypothesis and never derives it; ClockWavefront.lean has no temperature statement.

My run: (a) I fetched the wrong PMC id once (an unrelated mussel paper) and discarded it. (b) The pooled mean of the WT-growth sheet (about 29.5 um per somite) and the Nodal values were visible before the amendment; this is disclosed in prereg.md. (c) The combined held_all block for B was added after seeing the first results. (d) The B hold-out has n=3 and its shuffle control is inconclusive.
